verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at getlago.com/llms.txt. Docs pages are also served as markdown (.md), and those pages point agents to a complete documentation index at getlago.com/docs/llms.txt, so an agent can be aimed directly at agent-oriented docs. A machine-readable OpenAPI schema is also served. Missing for 10: first-party prose documentation explaining the llms.txt / markdown-docs offering, and independent community corroboration of agents using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://getlago.com/docs/llms.txt
